text:
Based on the provided abstract, the study evaluates 37 CMIP6 GCMs across 14 CORDEX domains using a multivariable integrated evaluation method to evaluate climatological mean and interannual variability, defines the similarity of multivariate error fields between pairwise models to measure interdependency, and hierarchically clusters the top 15 models. 

The candidate hypothesis introduces specific concepts, frameworks, and tools not supported or mentioned in the evidence, including a "hierarchical Bayesian framework", the "Multivariable Integrated Evaluation Tool (MVIETool)", a "multivariable integrated skill score (MISS)", and specific claims that do not align with the actual methodology and focus of the presented abstract.

VERDICT: REJECT
